answers.core: EXRs are used a lot in the animation/VFX industry, and it provides a ton of data that can be used in post production. Having support for exporting to EXR seems to make a ton of sense. Also, not sure how well this would be supported outside of the core.
answers.workaround: If this isn't used, then it will likely have to be exported via GDExtensions, if GDExtensions supports arbitrary outputs from the movie mode.

title: Implement OpenEXR output for Movie Maker mode
